Access You're from Nidal.

You've been riding so long that the saddle feels like solid ground. You take only a –1 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves while mounted. If your mount is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Unconscious] and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone], you can Mount to dismount your mount as a free action, standing in an unoccupied square of your choosing adjacent to your mount.
